panel.title: Keyboard light
panel.noSensor: No light sensor on this machine. The level stays where you set it, and still turns off when you stop typing.
panel.idleHelp: The light fades out after you stop typing, and comes back on the next key or touch.
panel.roomHelp: At or under Dark below, the keys use the dark level. At or over Bright above, they use the bright level.
panel.held: Holding %1% until the room light changes.
panel.hint: j/k move · h/l adjust · a toggles auto · enter uses the reading
